data_port.description: Starting port number for data streams (nuttcp -p)

window_size.description: TCP window size in KB (nuttcp -w). 0 means use system default.

server_window.description: Server-specific TCP window size in KB (nuttcp -ws). 0 means same as window_size.

transmit_rate_limit.description: Rate limit (e.g., '1000' for Kbps, '1000m' for Mbps). Empty for unlimited (nuttcp -R)

num_buffers.description: Number of buffers to transfer. 0 for unlimited (nuttcp -n)

dscp_value.description: DSCP or TOS value (nuttcp -c). Empty for no marking.

both_buffers.description: Set both send and receive buffer sizes (nuttcp -wb)

server_mode.description: Server mode: 'S' for persistent, '1' for one-shot (nuttcp -S or -1)

flip_connect.description: Flip connect for NAT/port block traversal (nuttcp -F)
